checklist.step: Locate and extract all public project disclosures (annual reports, investor presentations, filings) by Hindalco Industries Limited with clearly dated milestones.
checklist.expected_evidence: Company filings with project-level capacity announcements and milestones (e.g., announcement, trial, commissioning dates).
cross_validation_sources: Hindalco’s disclosures on SEC or stock exchange filings
checklist.completion_criteria: Evidence found and verified in a public, official document with dated project status and capacity disclosures.

checklist.step: Identify and retrieve official records from independent regulatory or system operators confirming commissioning of projects (e.g., power, smelter, manufacturing facilities).
checklist.expected_evidence: Official operational milestones or commissioning notices from NTPC, power grid operators, or ministry of new and renewable energy.
cross_validation_sources: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) reports
Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion (DIPP) project status records
checklist.completion_criteria: At least one independent, publicly accessible record confirms a project's commissioning or operational status beyond internal disclosures.

checklist.step: Standardize and reconcile metrics across all project disclosures (capacity, units, timeline) to ensure consistent definitions (e.g., KT, KTPA, MW).
checklist.expected_evidence: A consolidated table of project status with capacity, milestones, and standardized units.
checklist.calculation: Standardize units to kilotonnes (KT) or kilotonnes per annum (KTPA); map metrics to consistent time periods (FY 2023–24 to FY 2026).
checklist.completion_criteria: All project metrics are standardized and mapped to a consistent period and unit basis, with verified definitions.

checklist.step: Cross-check the reported project status (announced, under-implementation, commissioned) with independent records and prior disclosures.
checklist.expected_evidence: Corroboration that announced capacity has progressed to commissioning or remained under-implementation.
cross_validation_sources: Third-party analyst reports on project progress
checklist.completion_criteria: A clear distinction is established between announced and commissioned capacity with at least one independent verification.

alternative_explanation: Reported movements or status differences may reflect timing, scope, consolidation basis or definitions rather than underperformance or undisclosed exposure.
falsification_test: The defined comparison is reconciled on a consistent period, entity, unit and reporting basis, with independent records supporting the disclosed position.
